name: Leading A Child Astray
overview: The Scriptures solemnly warn against leading children who believe in Christ into sin, emphasizing the severe consequences for those who cause such offense, as illustrated by the imagery of a millstone around the neck and being cast into the sea. Jesus highlights the preciousness of little children in the kingdom of heaven, urging believers to welcome and protect them rather than hinder their faith. These passages underscore the gravity of influencing young believers and the call to nurture their spiritual well-being with utmost care.
